title: Three-Generation Funeral Home Adapting to Direct Cremation
setting: The creaky, century-old Hale Funeral Home sits on a tree-lined main street in rural Ohio, its front showroom still lined with handcrafted oak caskets passed down through three generations. Third-generation owner Mara Hale struggles to keep the family business afloat as local families increasingly choose affordable direct cremations over traditional viewings and full burials, forcing her to confront changes that clash with her family’s long-held legacy.

characters.name: Jessa Mae
characters.tendencies: She greets every grieving family with gentle, traditional courtesy while quietly researching direct cremation compliance rules to support the business’s evolving needs.

characters.name: Elara Voss
characters.tendencies: She writes clear, empathetic outreach materials and answers phone inquiries to help families understand direct cremation without dismissing traditional funeral preferences.

characters.name: Toby Cole
characters.tendencies: He maintains the funeral home’s equipment, assists with all funeral preparations, and balances respect for the family’s legacy with willingness to adopt modern direct cremation workflows.
